points.text: The linked article reports that GTA VI's shaders start loading on omonkey's build, streamed live on Rumble.
The tracker records that Rico joined the board, claiming the stage "Runnable".
The tracker records that ASTRAL joined the board, claiming the stage "First frame".

sentences.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two filed a DMCA notice naming Leonida and GitHub applied it to 3,007 repositories.
The linked article says Leonida's Discord server stopped resolving late Monday and members say Discord banned it.
The linked article says the repository moved from the creator's personal account to a new organization.
Hardware Busters reports that Project Leonida went dark as fake builds spread malware.
MakeUseOf claims that fake GTA 6 installers steal accounts for a non-existent port.
Yahoo Tech says GTA 6 sparks privacy concerns over Rockstar and Take-Two knowledge of players.
The linked article reports that private builds now play through Lucia's prologue and into Jason's first mission, though rendering is rough.
TechRadar claims that unofficial ports are making rapid progress, with Chapter 1 reportedly playable.
